subject: S1 sigma0 tiles: sea-surface tie points
description: Owner decision 2026-10-20: ticket now, fix later. Found by the review of task 0112. imint/data/s1_shared.py read_window warps GCP-referenced GRD with the product's own tie points (ellipsoid height ~0) through GDAL's 2-D TPS, which drops Z. It serves mpc_s1.fetch_s1_scene and the sigma0 training tiles of imint/training/aws_s1.py and imint/training/cdse_s1_stac.py. By the geometry measured for the vessel chain (task 0112) the sea in those tiles sits (N - z)/tan(inc) toward the satellite, 41-56 m off Skagen (expected, not yet measured on the tiles). Fix: route the sigma0 warp through the vessel chain's sea-surface tie points (one helper, no second geocoding path), version the tiles' cache, and add a regression test against independent truth (range-Doppler oracle and/or AIS hull centres) before any tile is regenerated. Decide with the owner how models trained on the old tiles are handled. Projected RTC COGs (imint/training/pc_s1_rtc.py) do not use this warp and are out of scope.
